messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Re: ROC Curve
parts:
Hi Nivedita,

Cardinal doesn't currently provide such a function, but there are plenty of ways to plot an ROC curve in R.

Here is one way using the 'roc.plot' function from the 'verification' package:

library(CardinalWorkflows)
library(verification)
data(rcc_analyses)
scores <- rcc.sscg$probabilities[[1]][,"cancer"]
labels <- pData(rcc.sscg)$diagnosis == "cancer"
roc.plot(labels, scores)

-Kylie
